evidence: 3 runs all collided while moving (not during stop) with closing speeds 0.23-0.7 m/s
First mover within 2m detected 4-15s before collision, but TTC > 2.0s threshold delayed evasion
Evasion triggered (evading flag active) yet collisions still occurred due to insufficient maneuver effectiveness

assumptions.assumption: Current TTC threshold (2.0s) is too high for dynamic scenarios, causing evasion to trigger too late
assumptions.why: Collisions occurred with closing speeds >0.23 m/s and distances <2m for >4s, indicating TTC likely dropped below 2.0s before collision

assumptions.assumption: Fixed evasion duration (0.5s) is inadequate when collision risk persists beyond initial TTC trigger
assumptions.why: Multiple stop episodes logged but collisions still happened, suggesting evasion didn't fully mitigate risk

assumptions.assumption: Anchor-based evasion path selection fails when mover velocity vectors aren't fully integrated into trajectory prediction
assumptions.why: Mover positions/velocities change dynamically; static anchor penalty (1.2m) may not account for mover motion during evasion

approach_families.result: mixed: reduced collisions but increased timeouts or new collisions

candidates.idea: Dynamic evasion duration based on real-time TTC instead of fixed _EVADE_HOLD
candidates.for: Ensures evasion continues while collision risk remains, addressing delayed reaction from fixed 0.5s hold
candidates.risk: May cause prolonged stops if TTC fluctuates near threshold

candidates.idea: Integrate mover velocity vectors into candidate scoring using relative motion prediction
candidates.for: Improves evasion path selection by anticipating mover movement beyond static anchor penalty
candidates.risk: Increased computational load; requires accurate velocity estimation

candidates.idea: Immediate speed reduction when movers within 3m regardless of TTC, with hysteresis for resumption
candidates.for: Provides earlier reaction than TTC alone, leveraging proximity detection
candidates.risk: Over-sensitivity may cause unnecessary slowdowns in static environments

diagnosis.chosen: Implement dynamic evasion duration tied to TTC > 2.0s condition instead of fixed 0.5s hold, as collisions occurred despite active evasion due to premature resumption
diagnosis.target: controller function's evade_until logic and _choose integration
diagnosis.direction: When TTC triggers evasion, set evade_until to t + _EVADE_HOLD but also extend it if TTC remains < 2.0s; recalculate TTC every frame during evasion; prioritize lateral evasion candidates with larger angular deviation from mover bearing; incorporate mover velocity vectors into _choose scoring via relative motion prediction; reduce _ANCHOR_R to 0.8m for tighter evasion around closest mover; validate evasion effectiveness via lidar clearance metrics before resuming motion
